title: "Rookie-transcripts"
format: html
---

```{r}
source('R/Rookie-vars.R')
tar_load(transcripts)
tar_load(transcripts_html)
```

```{r}
transcripts_html
transcripts
```

```{r}
transcripts |> count(season)
```

```{r}

transcripts |> 
  mutate(
    count_Chen = str_count(transcript, "(?<!MRS\\.\\s)(?<!Mrs\\.\\s)CHEN"),
    .keep = "unused",
    .after = title
  ) |> 
  arrange(count_Chen) |> 
  select(1:6)

transcripts |> 
  mutate(count_Chen = str_count(transcript, "(?<!MRS\\.\\s)(?<!Mrs\\.\\s)CHEN"), .keep = "unused") |> 
  mutate(ep_ID = as_factor(ep_ID) |> fct_reorder(count_Chen) |> fct_rev()) |>
  ggplot(aes(ep_ID, count_Chen)) +
  geom_col() + 
  theme_light() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5))

```

```{r}
transcripts |> 
  mutate(
    Chen_mentions = str_count(transcript, "(?<!Mrs\\.\\s)Chen"),
    .after = title
  ) |> 
  select(1:6)

transcripts |> 
  mutate(
    count_Chen = str_count(transcript, "(?<!MRS\\.\\s)(?<!Mrs\\.\\s)CHEN"),
    Chen_mentions = str_count(transcript, "(?<!Mrs\\.\\s)Chen"),
    .keep = "unused"
  ) |> 
  # mutate(ep_ID = as_factor(ep_ID) |> fct_reorder(count_Chen) |> fct_rev()) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(episode_number, count_Chen), color = "blue") + 
  geom_point(aes(episode_number, Chen_mentions), color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(aes(episode_number, count_Chen), color = "blue") +
  geom_smooth(aes(episode_number, Chen_mentions), color = "red") + 
  # geom_line(aes(ep_ID, count_Chen, group = 1), color = "blue") +
  # geom_line(aes(ep_ID, Chen_mentions, group = 1), color = "red") +
  theme_light() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5))

```

```{r}

transcripts |> 
  mutate(
    murder = str_count(transcript, "(M|m)urder[(s|ed)]?\\s"),
    stabbing = str_count(transcript, "(S|s)tab[s|bing|bed]?\\s") +
      str_count(transcript, "(K|k)nifed"),
    assault = str_count(transcript, "(A|a)ssault[ed]?\\s"),
    suicide = str_count(transcript, "(S|s)uicid(e|al)"),
    .after = title
  )

transcripts |> 
  mutate(
    murder = str_count(transcript, "(M|m)urder[(s|ed)]?\\s"),
    stabbing = str_count(transcript, "(S|s)tab[s|bing|bed]?\\s") +
      str_count(transcript, "(K|k)nifed"),
    assault = str_count(transcript, "(A|a)ssault[ed]?\\s"),
    suicide = str_count(transcript, "(S|s)uicid(e|al)"),
    .after = title
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = ep_ID)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = murder), color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(y = stabbing), color = "red") +
  geom_point(aes(y = assault), color = "blue") +
  geom_point(aes(y = suicide), color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(x = "Episode", y = "Number of Mentions")

```

```{r}

transcripts |> 
  mutate(
    count_Chen = str_count(transcript, "(?<!MRS\\.\\s)(?<!Mrs\\.\\s)CHEN"),
    .keep = "unused",
    .after = title
  ) |> 
  select(1:6) |> 
  group_by(season) |> 
  summarise(sum = sum(count_Chen), avg = mean(count_Chen))

```
